'''IG-1'''<ref name="CSWE" /> was the retroactive<ref name="TNEGtD" /> code name given to the first [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] design developed by [[Phlut Design Systems/Legends|Phlut Design Systems]]<ref name="CSWE" /> as part of [[Project Phlutdroid/Legends|Project Phlutdroid]]<ref name="TNEGtD" /> after the relative success of its [[IG lancer droid/Legends|IG lancer droid]].<ref name="CSWE" /> However, the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] was ultimately left unproduced by PDS when the company's assets were seized by the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] shortly before the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]<ref name="TNEGtD" /> in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> The [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin]] droid's unpublished blueprints,<ref name="TNEGtD" /> along with those of the rest of the [[IG-series/Legends|IG-series]], were later acquired by [[Holowan Mechanicals/Legends|Holowan Mechanicals]]<ref name="CSWE" /> and relabeled IGs 1 through 99.<ref name="TNEGtD" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:H-TFUs_and_IG-1.png|thumb|right|250px|Concept designs for IG-1 and a pair of H-TFUs by Adam Nichols]]
The IG-1 was first mentioned in ''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]'', a [[2006]] [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] reference book written by [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="TNEGtD">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> [[Adam Nichols]] created an IG-1 concept design for the [[Krome Studios]] port of the [[2008]] video game ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed]]'', depicted alongside a pair of [[Heavy Tactical Fighting Unit]]s, though the assassin droid went unused in the final game.<ref name="Adam Nichols">{{WebCite|url=https://www.adamnichols.net/star_wars.php|text=Star Wars - The Force Unleashed|author=Adam Nichols|quote=IG-1 Droid Concept Design.|archivedate=20250405203411}}</ref>
